name: 25545 · Ona, WV
findings: ZIP 25545 (Ona) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25545 (Ona) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 25545 (Ona) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
